findings.text: the comment states the 877 s arm ran "with the cache directory unconfigured", but lane-20260918.log:8 prints JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR=/work/projects/imas_gpu/sophelio/jax-cache/nova-prewarm/nova/jax-compilation/runtime-7b315420b55b91bffb05 and its receipt records hits=56 misses=1285 compile_seconds=591.0 under the marker WALL-CLOCK-UNRELIABLE, so the directory was configured and empty only of that run's own programs; the reviewed node's manifest baseline_suite field corrects exactly this statement and the evidence record says "Configured on the way in", leaving the plan record as the one place that presents a configured arm as an unconfigured one and so undersells the comparison it reports.

the comment pairs 353 s against 877 s (the launcher's PYTEST_WALL_SECONDS readings) with "519 s less wall" (the pytest-native difference 861.11 minus 341.91 = 519.2, where 877 minus 353 = 524) without naming either instrument, and although the evidence record reconciles the two instruments against the 591.0 s compile accounting, the plan sentence is the only place the pair reads as a single measurement.

justifications.durability: All eleven commits carry a body with no attribution trailer, the receipts and figure are committed artifacts (cache-reuse.json with its PNG and SVG twin under docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/cache-prewarm), and the scripts' docstrings state the non-obvious mechanisms they rest on (prewarm_row.py:3-6 one process per program for the LLVM section allocator, publish_prewarm_pin.py:3-6 the key taken from the resolver, prewarm.sh:6-12 why the served directory must be exported), held below the top by the guard's unanchored marker, a known gap the node recorded rather than fixed.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced: the key sets re-derived from the live served directory give lane 1285, pin 3362, intersection 70, union 4577, with all 1285 lane keys written in hour 13 and the pin's 3292 exclusives in hours 14-15; the three failures are byte-identical across arms; the figure's bars are exactly proportional to cache-reuse.json at 4.09 px/s and 0.906 px/s with the 877/353 pair at ratio 2.485; and the receipt's 4577 program-key entries is correct against the directory's 4577 <program>-<key>-cache files plus the xla_gpu_per_fusion_autotune_cache_dir subtree the record itself names as excluded.
justifications.fit: The work implements the compile-cost decision's levers two and four (docs/plans/millisecond-converged-solve.html:473-475) inside the existing lane directory, follows the repo's figure conventions with the receipt committed behind both renders, brings AGENTS.md to the merged mechanism after 62b9c202 replaced the intermediate HOME recipe with NOVA_COMPILATION_CACHE_ROOT, and files the coverage gap as f-msc-lane-cache-coverage with its own gate.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Levers two and four of the compile-cost decision (docs/plans/millisecond-converged-solve.html:473) are delivered and measured end to end: prewarm.sh:96-129 fills the pinned root in one allocation with one process per row, publish_prewarm_pin.py:41-56 publishes the directory the resolver itself returns, and the guarded lane run reports 1341 hits, 0 misses, 0 compile seconds with the marker wall-clock-reliable misses=0 budget=0 at an enforced budget of zero, while the pre-warm's zero coverage of the lane's key set is recorded as the open followup f-msc-lane-cache-coverage instead of being papered over.
justifications.scope_discipline: The eleven commits touch exactly the declared paths (AGENTS.md, nova/jax/config.py, the five lane scripts, run.sh, the evidence record and the figure triplet), no tests/ file is modified anywhere in 299e4b64..e50f000e so no test contract was weakened, the three failures are attributed to node msc-forward-solve-lane-regressions (run r-20260918T165636099922 exists) and none was repaired here, and the plan write is a comment plus an open followup rather than a status flip.
